romance.title: Serial Dater
romance.description: The year is marked with relationships. You date several people throughout the year, each for about d12 weeks

romance.title: A Special Someone
romance.description: You find a certain someone whom you date for d12 months

romance.title: Ongoing Commitment
romance.description: A serious relationship has lasted into this year. Roll d12 - On a 1-5 it ends, on a 6-11 it continues through the year, on a 12 you marry

romance.title: Secret Affair
romance.description: You find someone else, while dating someone seriously. Roll d12 - odd they find out and dump you, even they never find out

romance.title: Betrayal
romance.description: Someone whom you'd been dating cheats on you. Roll d12. Even, you find out, odd they dump you and you don't know why

romance.title: Tragic Loss
romance.description: Someone whom you'd been dating for over a year dies

romance.title: Unexpected Pregnancy
romance.description: Pregnancy. Roll d12; 1-3 You leave, 4-6 He/she Leaves You, 7-8 You Marry, 9-12 Crossbow Point Wedding
